pairs: For her who pursues the inheritance.
Attend to the voice of my prayer,
For to you, I will pray.
Lord, you will hear my voice.
et videbo quoniam non Deus volens iniquitatem tu es.
I will stand before you, and I will see. For you are not a God who wills iniquity.
And the malicious will not dwell close to you,
neque permanebunt injusti ante oculos tuos.
nor will the unjust endure before your eyes.
You hate all who work iniquity.
You will destroy all who speak a lie.
Ego autem in multitudine misericordiæ tuæ introibo in domum tuam;
But I am in the multitude of your mercy. I will enter your house.
adorabo ad templum sanctum tuum in timore tuo.
I will show adoration toward your holy temple, in your fear.
propter inimicos meos dirige in conspectu tuo viam meam.
Because of my enemies, direct my way in your sight.
Quoniam non est in ore eorum veritas;
For there is no truth in their mouth:
Their throat is an open sepulcher.
linguis suis dolose agebant: judica illos,
They have acted deceitfully with their tongues. Judge them,
Let them fall by their own intentions:
secundum multitudinem impietatum eorum expelle eos,
according to the multitude of their impiety, expel them.
Et lætentur omnes qui sperant in te;
But let all those who hope in you rejoice.
and you will dwell in them.
Et gloriabuntur in te omnes qui diligunt nomen tuum,
And all those who love your name will glory in you.
For you will bless the just. You have crowned us,
ut scuto bonæ voluntatis tuæ coronasti nos.
O Lord, as if with a shield of your good will.
